data.value: The letter follows the outline of the profession's model letter. Read it through and complete it before sending it for signature.

data.value: Each team member records the time spent on this client here: the firm sees what the fixed fee earns.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Object.Text
data.value: {0} engages us for the {1}, starting with the financial year opened on {2}.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Object.Presentation
data.value: This engagement follows the professional standard of the French Order of Chartered Accountants for compilation engagements. It is neither an audit nor a review: at its end, we will issue a compilation report on the annual accounts.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Object.Bookkeeping
data.value: This engagement covers recording your transactions and keeping your books. It does not include preparing the annual accounts unless listed in the services below.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Object.Review
data.value: This engagement follows the professional standard for reviews. It aims at moderate assurance that the accounts are free from material misstatement; it is less extensive than an audit.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Services.Text
data.value: The engagement includes the following services:

data.name: Mission.Letter.Duration.Text
data.value: The engagement starts on {0} for one year. It renews automatically each year unless terminated by registered letter at least three months before it ends.

data.name: Mission.Letter.ClientDuties.Text
data.value: You undertake to provide all supporting documents and information in good time, to inform us of any significant or unusual event, and to confirm in writing at the end of the engagement that the documents provided are complete (representation letter).

data.name: Mission.Letter.CabinetDuties.Text
data.value: We will carry out the engagement in accordance with the profession's code of ethics and professional secrecy. Our professional liability is covered by insurance with a reputable insurer.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Fees.Text
data.value: Our fee is a fixed {0} excluding VAT per year, invoiced {1} ({2} excluding VAT per invoice).

data.name: Mission.Letter.Fees.Extra
data.value: Work not listed in this letter will be invoiced separately, with your prior agreement.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Privacy.Text
data.value: Personal data needed for the engagement is processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), only to carry out the engagement and for the retention period required of the profession.

data.name: Mission.Letter.Closing.Text
data.value: The attached general terms form part of this letter. Please return a dated and signed copy, marked “Read and approved”.
